text.description_html:
Acorn BH1JI, 6' Stainless Steel Barn Door Kit with Squared Door Mounts

The Stainless Steel Sliding Barn Door Kit with 6 Foot Track adds a modern take on the barn door. Perfect for New York City lofts and contemporary suburban homes alike, this barn door kit features stainless steel construction. Sold as a complete set, it includes everything you need to install a 3 foot barn door. It has an anti-jump block and floor guides to help keep your sliding door on track.

Features of the Acorn BH1JI, 6 Foot Track Rolling Barn Door Kit For 3 Foot Doors:

  • Kit package includes everything you need to install a barn door.
  • Made from marine grade stainless steel for durability and strength.
  • Anti-jump track blocks.
  • Easy to install.

Specifications of the Stainless Steel Barn Door Hardware Kit:

  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel
  • Track: 6 feet (72 inches)
  • For doors up to 3 feet (36 inches)
  • For wood doors up to 300 lbs.
  • Package Includes: 6' track, wheel Carriers, standoffs, end stops, anti jump blocks, and door bottom stabilizers.
  • Acorn Sliding Barn Door Kit Installation Instructions (PDF)

In case of a doorway larger than 3 feet, custom length tracks are available. Please Contact Us with your requirements or if you have any questions.
